study type: Comparative Cross-sectional study with in vitro experiments
cohort: The study included women with preterm preeclampsia (n=44) and gestation-matched normotensive preterm controls (n=26) who delivered at less than 34 weeks gestation.
finding: Steroid sulfatase (STS) expression was significantly elevated in preeclamptic placentas and maternal whole blood, and siRNA knockdown of STS in primary trophoblasts resulted in a modest but significant reduction in sFlt1 secretion.
cross-section timing: At the time of delivery, for those delivering at <34 weeks gestation.
